data: Hello! My name is Kanishk (He/Him) and I'm an MS/MBA student affiliated with Harvard Business School and Harvard SEAS. Before joining the Variation Lab, I spent 7 years working as a Forward Deployed Engineer at Microsoft, where I got to work on some cool problems including "make cream cheese flow good" and "is it sunny in sweden?" I work on helping accelerate human learning using AI tooling, and on AI ethics and governance. I also write short stories, and am actively founding. Feel free to reach out and chat, I love yapping.
